results.statement: For four independent cap-one original coordinates, invertible symmetric 4x4 M and arbitrary affine terms, the quadratic-plus-affine form has an essentially bounded density with norm <93 |det M|^{-1/4}.

For a literal physical pair H with delta=det H nonzero, K=delta C-E^T adj(H)E, and environment coordinate j, Pi_3(B_j)=|delta|^{-1} sqrt(det(E_J E_J^T)) ||P_{ker E_J}K[j,J]||. The completed three-hub theorem then gives a continuous density cap 3sqrt(2)(|delta|/Theta_j)^{1/3}.

partner_result_applied.application: Used D|lambda|>=1/4 and the maximal-bank diffuse/transverse gate for <110.481; combined D|lambda|>=1/4 with the new three-hub identity to obtain <26.940 when h_j^2>=1/64 and det G^(-j)>=1/64.

structural_warning: Large off-diagonal Frobenius norm of K_H alone does not imply a useful physical 4-volume: rank-one K=hh^T can have order-one off-diagonal Frobenius mass while every anchored 2x2 determinant vanishes.
